title: NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE is a dead constant — the named panel-width scale is not the derivation source of NOC_PANEL_W
evidence:
NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE :: 1.4            // the panel-width scale (the ruling)
NOC_PANEL_W       :: 360 * 14 / 10 // 504 (= 360 × NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE, exact int math) — the rail width
detail: Hard rule 2 requires the "panel-width scale" to be a named tunable. NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE is never referenced by any expression (grep of app/ + harness/ finds only its definition and comments); the width actually derives from magic integers 14/10, so tuning the named scale silently changes nothing.
recommended_fix: Derive the width from the named scale, e.g. NOC_PANEL_W :: i32(360 * NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE + 0.5), so the scale constant is the single tunable source.

title: NOC_CONTENT_Y=116 only clears a ≤4-row forecast; longer forecasts and the R4 upgrade-preview card occlude the rail's headline rows
evidence:
NOC_CONTENT_Y     :: 116            // the first content row's y (below the top band)
--- forecast.odin ---
		h := title_h + i32(rows) * line_h + pad
---
			preview_y = y + title_h + i32(rows) * line_h + pad + hud(v, 6)
		}
		draw_upgrade_preview(v, cat, preview, x, preview_y, card_w, pad, line_h, title_h)
detail: Spec: "place carefully vs the top-band cards". With y=10, title_h=24, line_h=20, pad=10, a 5-row forecast reaches y=134, and the preview card stacks up to 12+ rows below it at x≈1030..1280 — over the rail plate (756..1280) and its right-aligned columns, drawn after the rail, hiding rail content below y=116.
recommended_fix: Start rail content below the live top-band bottom (query the forecast/preview card extent like crisis_card_width does), or clamp/skip rail rows intersecting the card stack.

title: font-check harness verb still renders the NOC overlay with the old draw order and no fit-to-rail
evidence:
rl.BeginDrawing()
	rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, &state.topology, &state.bundles, &state.flow, &state.crisis, sim_tick, {}, -1, -1, state.seed)
	rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, &state.crisis, cat, state.era)
	rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&rc.view, &state.crisis, cat, state.era, banner_y)
	rnd.draw_noc_overlay(&rc.view, &feed, &stats, &state.topology, &state.bundles, cat, state.events[:], -1, u32(len(state.flow.packets)), 0)
detail: The diff updated overlay-check and overlay-pixels to view_set_rail + world→rail→top-band order, but font-check (which claims to mirror "the same shipped draw calls") still draws the overlay last at the full-window fit — its captures no longer represent the app's D-on frame.
recommended_fix: In font_check, call rnd.view_set_rail(&rc.view, true) after setup and move draw_noc_overlay before draw_forecast_panel/draw_health_meter/draw_crisis_banner, matching overlay_check.
